title: Style-Debiased DPO: Updating LLM Knowledge with Factuality-Aware Synthetic Preference Data
abstract: arXiv:2609.16532v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continued pretraining (CPT) with data augmentation such as paraphrasing can store inside a large language model (LLM) the knowledge of a small source corpus. The stored knowledge, however, is not always retrieved correctly. We study the eliciting side rather than the storing side: we use preference optimization, which learns from pairs of a preferred (chosen) and a dispreferred (rejected) response, so that the model elicits its stored knowledge more accurately. One proposed approach takes the model's own erroneous response as rejected and the gold answer as chosen, so as to suppress the error. When the target knowledge is partially known, however, most of these rejected responses are factually correct. Using direct preference optimization (DPO) then pushes down rejected responses that contain correct knowledge and differ from the chosen answer only in style, such as length and wording. translated_title: 风格去偏DPO：利用事实感知的合成偏好数据更新LLM知识
translated_abstract: 通过改写等数据增强手段进行的持续预训练（CPT）可以将小型源语料库的知识存储到大型语言模型（LLM）中。然而，这些存储的知识并不总能被正确检索出来。我们研究的是知识的引出端而非存储端：我们使用偏好优化方法，通过从首选（chosen）和不偏好（rejected）回答的配对中学习，使模型更准确地引出其存储的知识。一种已提出的方法是将模型自身的错误回答作为rejected、将标准答案作为chosen，以此抑制错误。然而，当目标知识被部分掌握时，这些被拒绝的回答大多在事实上是正确的。此时使用直接偏好优化（DPO）会压低那些包含正确知识、且与chosen答案仅在风格（如长度和措辞）上不同的rejected回答。我们提出风格去偏DPO（SD-DPO），它通过评分……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出SD-DPO方法，通过对合成偏好数据进行风格去偏，避免DPO错误地压低仅风格不同但事实正确的回答，从而使LLM更准确地引出持续预训练中存储的知识。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes SD-DPO, a style-debiased variant of DPO that prevents down-weighting factually correct responses differing only in style, enabling LLMs to more accurately elicit knowledge stored during continued pretraining using factuality-aware synthetic preference data.
